svg.text: the same results against the total number of individuals
Size weights waste the extra individuals
the PLS test of a, with size weights
Simulated data with a fixed population: groups differ by τ² = 0.02, and their population means relate to the annotations with R² = 0.5 (κ = 0.5, Kish 40%).
7,200 data sets, 300 per cell. Dashed line: the nominal rate, 0.05. Bands: 95% intervals. Darker lines: more groups.
More individuals sharpen each group mean but add no observations of the annotations; once the means are precise (n̄ well above σ²_w/τ² = 50), only more groups add power.
